en.headline: Observatory forecasts urban temperatures down to 14 degrees under northeast monsoon
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory said cloudy skies with rain patches will bring appreciably cooler conditions today, with wind chill making it feel colder especially in the New Territories.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory said an intense northeast monsoon continues to affect the Guangdong coast while a cloud and rain band covers southern China, bringing appreciably cooler weather to Hong Kong on Friday.

Urban temperatures are expected to fall from about 18 degrees initially to around 14 degrees later in the day, with readings one or two degrees lower across the New Territories and cold conditions in parts of the New Territories and on high ground, the Observatory said.

Skies will remain cloudy with a few rain patches and moderate to fresh north to northeasterly winds that may occasionally reach strong force offshore and on high ground. The wind chill effect will make conditions feel colder, and the Observatory advised the public, particularly those outdoors, to stay warm and look after the elderly and people with chronic conditions.

Looking ahead, the Observatory said Saturday is expected to turn gradually fine though remaining rather cool in the morning, with cloud increasing and winds strengthening over the following days before another cool spell mid-week.

zh.headline: 天文台料強烈東北季候風下市區氣溫降至14度
zh.dek: 香港天文台表示，受強烈東北季候風及雲雨帶影響，本港今日顯著轉涼，密雲有幾陣雨，風寒效應令體感更冷，新界部分地區及高地寒冷。
body: 香港天文台表示，一股強烈東北季候風正影響廣東沿岸，同時一道雲雨帶覆蓋華南，本港今日天氣顯著轉涼。
天文台預測，市區氣溫由初時約18度進一步下降至稍後約14度，新界再低一兩度，新界部分地區及高地寒冷。
天氣密雲，有幾陣雨，吹和緩至清勁北至東北風，離岸及高地間中吹強風。由於風寒效應，體感溫度會更低，天文台提醒市民特別是進行戶外活動的人士留意天氣變化，注意保暖，並關顧長者及慢性病患者。
展望星期六漸轉天晴，但早上仍然相當清涼。隨後一兩日雲量增多，風勢頗大，氣溫稍為回升，下周中期再度轉涼。
